anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: Promotion is certificate-locked. No champion promotion without a valid candidate-specific Referee certificate; no bypass flag, env override, or default-allow path exists (source-scan guard-tested); a Playbook certificate can never satisfy a strategy promotion. (critical)
anti_goal_violations.evidence: The certificate's 'candidate-specific' property is enforced only against the MINT CALLER'S OWN DECLARED PIN, never against the evidence the statistics were computed from. apps/backend/app/research/referee_adjudicate.py:521 `_pool_strategy_trades(journal_store)` and apps/backend/app/research/referee_evidence.py:826 `strategy_observations(journal_store)` both take only a JournalStore and pool EVERY recorded backtest report's trades, unfiltered by result['strategy_id']/['profile']; `_mint_strategy_certificate` then stamps whatever `candidate` dict its caller handed it. Demonstrated end-to-end by the evaluator in an isolated tmp store: 12 planted backtests all belonging to strategy_id='v1'/profile='default' minted an attested, gate-passing certificate naming candidate {'strategy_id': 'totally-unrelated-strategy', 'profile': 'totally-unrelated-profile'}, and authorize_promotion then returned {'authorized': True} for that unrelated candidate while refusing v1/default with 'no_certificate'. The reviewer independently flagged the same unscoped pooling as a NOTE (reports/reviews/goal-referee-iter-9-review.md, referee_adjudicate.py:521).
anti_goal_violations.severity_reasoning: Scored MINOR, not critical, because it is UNREACHABLE by any operator action this era and nothing is stored: the evaluator grepped every production call site of run_evaluation_and_record (only referee_adjudicate.py:1512, the compute manager, and :1854, the CLI) and neither supplies journal_store or certificate_mint, so no route, UI action, or CLI act can mint any certificate at all; the operator's real registry dir (apps/backend/.data/referee_registry) does not exist on disk, so zero certificates are on file and every live promotion is refused with 'no_certificate' — exactly the behavior goal.md declares ('no strategy certificate can honestly exist this era'). It is recorded unresolved because it must be closed BEFORE any future era wires journal_store/certificate_mint into the /evaluate route, at which point the interlock would become ceremonial.
anti_goal_violations.unblock_options: Either (a) scope _pool_strategy_trades/strategy_observations to the certificate's own (strategy_id, profile) candidate and cross-check the mint's declared candidate against the pooled evidence's identity, or (b) an explicit owner ruling that a caller-declared pin is sufficient while the mint stays route-unreachable, recorded in the assumption ledger.
